en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
, and the floating fish were mentioned and the people dislike from it. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather, the floating from the fish are abhorred and it is what its smell has changed’.
en.sarwar: 18. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Once, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
mentioned fish which floats on water and what people dislike. He (the Imam) said, ‘The fish floating on the water are disliked because their smell has changed.’”
